status: descriptive analysis of frozen records; no thermal run, no fitting, no selection

estimands.e_Q: sqrt of the hierarchical mean of r_Q^2, r_Q = ln(max(Q_model, 1 px) / max(Q_camera, 1 px)), Q in {H, W} (A26)
estimands.J: 0.5 e_H^2 + 0.5 e_W^2 over a group's conditions (A26)
estimands.median_ratio: median of exp(r_Q) over a unit's pooled scored frames (descriptive)
estimands.v_ratio: e_Q(held out) / e_Q(calibration), each over its own conditions (reading V, plan 22.4.3.2)
estimands.slopes: least squares of ln(coupon median) on [1, ln P, ln v] or [1, ln VED]
estimands.ratio_trend: least squares of the coupon median r_Q on [1, ln VED] over 24 coupons
estimands.replicate_difference: ln(coupon median 0731 / 0730) for sizes, plain difference for e and median r (T10)
estimands.oracle_floor: e of a predictor equal to the camera's own track median, coupon median or other-day coupon median for every frame (T10)
estimands.variance_partition: exact frame-weighted sum-of-squares split: within track, between tracks in a coupon, between coupons in a condition, between conditions (T12)
estimands.icc_design_effect: one-way random-effects ICC (ANOVA, unbalanced n0), deff = 1 + (mean cluster size - 1) ICC, effective n = N / deff (T12)
estimands.within_coupon_power: Spearman of model and camera over frames and track medians; coupon e against camera frames shuffled within the coupon (T12)
estimands.bland_altman: coupon median r_Q against the geometric mean of the coupon median sizes; bias and 1.96 SD limits over the 14 in-window coupons (F8)
estimands.operator_comparison: the contract hierarchy applied to the reading-S synthetic camera against the re-measured camera, recomputed from synthetic_frames.csv.gz (T14)
estimands.sensitivity_variants: e and J under frame/track/coupon weighting, pixel floors 0.5/1/2 px, no-pool frames left out, minimum track length, leave one coupon out (T15)

weighting: every level an unweighted mean of the level below (A10); frame counts never weight tracks, coupons or conditions
inferential_unit: coupon (24) and condition (18); frames (24,129 scored) are not independent observations

families.1: groups of >= 2 coupons: coupons resampled with replacement within the group; hierarchy recomputed with multiplicity weights; a condition absent from a draw drops out
families.2: coupons, conditions and one-coupon groups: scan tracks resampled with replacement within each coupon (within-coupon uncertainty only)
families.3: process slopes: coupons resampled within the subset; draws with a rank-deficient design skipped and counted
families.4: ratio-vs-VED trend: coupons resampled over all 24
families.5: replicate pairs (T10): scan tracks resampled within each coupon of a pair, independently; index = the coupon's position among the 24
families.6: permutation control (T12): camera values shuffled across a coupon's scored frames, 1000 permutations per coupon; index = the coupon's position among the 24
families.7: Bland-Altman bias (F8): the 14 in-window coupons resampled; index 0 = H, 1 = W
families.8: operator slopes (T14): coupons resampled over all 24, one set of draws shared by every operator

bootstrap.v_ratio_intervals: held out / calibration: families 1 and 1 (independent groups); part_5 / calibration: family 2 (part_5) over family 1 (calibration)

missing_values.undefined_frames: excluded and counted, never fabricated (A23); none occurred for confirm_c1
missing_values.no_pool_frames: scored as H = W = 0 (D1) with the 1 px floor; model size medians use frames with a predicted pool
missing_values.excluded_by_rule: first and last eligible frame of every scan track (A22); listed in D7
missing_values.camera_invalid: laser-on mapped frames with non-finite camera H/W (3 frames); never in residuals; listed in D7
missing_values.synthetic_unpaired: frames without a synthetic or re-measured camera blob are left out of the synthetic-operator scores and counted as lost coverage (T14)
missing_values.zero_width_blobs: synthetic blobs of zero width have no H/W shape; left out of shape medians only

predeclared_vs_exploratory.T5: record (values read from the code at build time; consistency across stage manifests checked)
predeclared_vs_exploratory.T6: predeclared selection rule; values from the committed runs
predeclared_vs_exploratory.T7: point values = reading C (predeclared, descriptive reading); intervals exploratory
predeclared_vs_exploratory.T8: point ratios = reading V (predeclared, V_PASS); intervals and bootstrap shares exploratory
predeclared_vs_exploratory.T9: Spearman values = reading X (predeclared, X_PARTIAL); coupon and group intervals exploratory
predeclared_vs_exploratory.T10: exploratory (replicates and measurement floor; plan Part 1, item 3)
predeclared_vs_exploratory.T11: exploratory (results report 4 was descriptive, not predeclared)
predeclared_vs_exploratory.T12: exploratory (variance, effective sample size, within-coupon power; plan Part 1, item 4)
predeclared_vs_exploratory.T14: synthetic-camera values = reading S (predeclared, S_DESCRIPTIVE); width-matched and threshold rows = 22.3.8 predeclared readings R-b, Q-b and Step 0; operator slopes exploratory
predeclared_vs_exploratory.T15: exploratory (descriptive sensitivity on frozen records; no new search)
predeclared_vs_exploratory.F4: recorded surrogate of the predeclared procedure; slices and guard boundary descriptive
predeclared_vs_exploratory.F6: points: reading X inputs (predeclared Spearman); fitted trend and band exploratory
predeclared_vs_exploratory.F13: descriptive illustration (frame chosen by a fixed rule)
predeclared_vs_exploratory.D6: record, with an independent reconstruction of the selection

verification: every coupon and group e_H, e_W, J and median ratio recomputed from the unit files equals the evaluate manifest to <= 1e-12; the synthetic-operator scores equal the synthetic manifest; the sync mapping equals the 22.3.6 audit; the selection is reconstructed from the recorded scores (PROVENANCE.json)
scale_caveat: micrometres use the nominal 8 um/px (A24); shapes, slopes, ratios of errors and rank correlations are scale-free (T14 E)
held_out_status: the 8 A8 held-out members were opened by the 22.4.3.2 evaluation after its freeze (A8, A27); this package uses them descriptively only
